info.name: ExecuTorch .pte (CPU int8 + QNN pass-through)
info.description: Packages the trained model as an ExecuTorch program (.pte) for the CPU (XNNPACK, optional PT2E int8), and passes through the learning block's NPU program (model_qnn.pte + export_report.json) when present. Includes a minimal Python runtime harness.

parameters.name: ExecuTorch backend
parameters.help: Delegate the model to this ExecuTorch backend when lowering to .pte.
